claude.rationale: The Company survived intact as a wholly owned subsidiary and the operating partnership (FOG units, the vehicles through which the business is conducted) was acquired 100%, so the customer-facing investment-management product and its operating processes crossed the boundary together — no product-vs-process mismatch (gap_45=0). The Founders Agreement, amended employment agreements, "Founder Matters" reservation of day-to-day operating authority to each Principal "in a manner consistent with the practice of the Acquired Companies prior to the Founders Closing," and the Principal Compensation Plan contractually carried forward the people/management running operations rather than transferring processes without their organization (gap_56=0). Because SoftBank's control was installed while the Principals' operating intent, board seats, and segment authority persisted, T1 is coded imprint-share.

grok.rationale: At closing SoftBank (via Parent/Merger Sub) took 100% ownership while the investment-management franchise, surviving LLC entity, and customer-facing AUM/products continued intact under the same firm, with no product-vs-process split documented (gap_45=0). Concurrently the Founders Agreement and amended employment agreements contractually reserved day-to-day segment operations, hiring, and new-product authority to the same Principals and carried forward their employment/compensation terms, so processes and the organization that runs them transferred/aligned together (gap_56=0); no TSA was needed to bridge a mismatch.

openai.rationale: The merger transferred the entire investment manager, with Fortress surviving as Parent's wholly owned subsidiary, while the concurrent Founders Closing transferred 100% of the remaining operating-partnership units. The product and operating processes therefore crossed the boundary together, and the Founders Agreement expressly preserved the Principals' day-to-day authority over segment operations and new-product creation consistent with pre-closing practice. The Principals also remained directors and entered five-year employment agreements effective at closing, documenting coherent transfer and alignment of the people and management responsible for those processes.
